description: DREX-V2 Antigravity Safety and Integrity Hooks

pre_tool_execution.name: block_destructive_system_disk_writes
pre_tool_execution.description: Protects against accidental physical drive destruction on system disks (C:, PhysicalDrive0, boot, EFI)

pre_tool_execution.name: block_mass_deletion
pre_tool_execution.description: Prevents unmanifested mass deletion of workspace source directories

post_tool_execution.name: verify_file_integrity
post_tool_execution.description: Verifies that source file modifications do not corrupt syntax or test baselines
